instruction.name: vrepli.d
instruction.description: Load an immediate into all d elements.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vldi $vr0, 1; vldi $vr1, 1; vldi $vr2, 1; vldi $vr3, 1; vldi $vr4, 1; vldi $vr5, 1; vldi $vr6, 1; vldi $vr7, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'nop' --asm 'vldi $vr0, 1; vldi $vr1, 1; vldi $vr2, 1; vldi $vr3, 1; vldi $vr4, 1; vldi $vr5, 1; vldi $vr6, 1; vldi $vr7, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.29 cycles. Measured CPI 0.2863; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LSX vector instruction measured on LA664.
